description: A diagnostic-only exception handler introduces a module-wide import prerequisite.
trigger: Import exllamav3, or a module that loads util.memory, in an environment where import reaches memory.py but pydantic is missing or does not expose PydanticUserError.
expected_behavior: Importing memory helpers such as free_mem, or importing Model without running the diagnostic, should not require the diagnostic's exception class.
actual_behavior: The new top-level import fails before any memory helper is defined. Model imports those helpers during package initialization, so the failure can occur without calling list_gpu_tensors.

verification.description: Traced the top-level import through the package and model initializers, checked direct memory importers and the absence of literal diagnostic invocations, and compared the unchanged package requirements with the new import.
verification.limits: The failure is conditional on the environment. No dependency resolution, version matrix or package import was executed.

introductions.rationale: This commit adds the eager exception import to the memory utility. The conditional requirement is source-supported and accepted as suspected.
